seo.title: Valam | Private Personal Finance App with an AI Money Coach
seo.description: Valam tracks spending, loans, credit cards, goals and money with friends, and coaches you with Mathi, an AI that runs on your phone. No ads, no data selling. Free to start.

hero.title: Your money, understood. Your data, yours alone.
hero.subtitle: Valam brings your accounts, cards, loans, goals and shared expenses into one calm place. Mathi, your AI coach, answers on your phone, so your finances never have to leave it.

heroImage.alt: Valam home screen showing net worth, safe to spend and upcoming bills

problem.title: Money apps ask for everything. Valam asks for nothing.
problem.body: Most finance apps upload your bank messages and spending to someone else's server. Valam does the opposite. It keeps your ledger in an encrypted vault on your phone and runs its intelligence there too.

points.title: Others
items: Show ads based on your spending

points.title: Valam
items: Keeps your ledger on your phone
Has no ads and no trackers
Needs no sign up to start

features.title: Everything about your money, in one place
features.subtitle: From a quick coffee to a home loan, Valam keeps the whole picture clear and tells you what needs attention.

items.title: Accounts and spending
items.body: Add every account, log expenses in seconds and let Valam sort them into categories. It learns from your corrections.

items.title: Credit cards
items.body: Track limits, statement dates and interest with reminders before every due date, so you never pay a late fee.

items.title: Loans and EMIs
items.body: See what you owe, how much interest you will pay and how fast you could be free with a payoff plan.

items.title: Friends and family
items.body: Keep a clear record of who owes whom. Split bills in groups and settle up with confirmed payments.

items.title: Goals and savings
items.body: Set a goal, link a savings pot and add money as you go. Valam shows if you are on track.

items.title: Wealth and funds
items.body: Follow investments, chit funds, deposits and reimbursements next to your everyday spending.

items.title: One calendar
items.body: Every bill, EMI, card due date and subscription renewal in a single view.

items.title: Easy import
items.body: Bring in history from bank CSV or OFX files, and on Android from bank SMS, all processed on your phone.

showcase.title: Skip the spreadsheets. Just ask Mathi.
showcase.subtitle: Real questions, answered with your own numbers. Here is what Mathi takes off your plate.

screens.label: Ask
screens.title: Get a straight answer
screens.body: Ask what you can spend today and Mathi replies in plain words, using your real balance, bills and budgets.
screens.alt: Mathi telling the user how much is safe to spend today

screens.title: Add an expense by chatting
screens.body: Say what you spent. Mathi drafts the entry and nothing is saved until you press Confirm and save.

screens.label: Remind
screens.title: Never miss a due date
screens.body: Ask which bills are due and get every EMI, card bill and chit payment in one list, with dates and amounts.

screens.label: Plan
screens.title: See your way out of debt
screens.body: Mathi compares payoff strategies, shows your debt free date and what an extra payment would save.

steps.title: Up and running in four steps

items.title: Install and secure
items.body: Open Valam and set up your vault. It is protected by Face ID, fingerprint or your phone PIN, plus a recovery key shown once.

items.title: Add your accounts
items.body: Add accounts, cards and loans, or import a statement file. Nothing is uploaded.

items.title: Track or import
items.body: Log spending in seconds or let Valam read your import. Categories sort themselves and improve as you correct them.

items.title: Get guided
items.body: See your safe to spend figure, spot problems early and ask Mathi what to do next.

mathi.title: A money coach that stays on your phone
mathi.body: Mathi (மதி) means good sense. Ask about affording a purchase, paying off a loan, or building a savings habit. Mathi reads your real numbers, shows what it checked, and keeps to money topics only.

image.alt: Chat with Mathi, the Valam AI money coach

points.title: Runs on your device
points.body: The on-device model answers without sending your questions to a server.

points.title: Numbers checked
points.body: Figures in a reply are checked against your ledger before you see them.

points.title: Only money topics
points.body: Anything unrelated to money is declined before it reaches the model.

points.title: Drafts, never decisions
points.body: Mathi can prepare an expense or payment for you, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

sampleChat.text: Can I afford a 45,000 rupee laptop this month?
A laptop for ₹45,000 is tight. It is more than your remaining spending room of ₹4,946, so it would come out of savings. Waiting a month, or saving towards it, keeps your plan intact.

privacy.title: Built so we could not read your data even if we wanted to
privacy.subtitle: Security is not a feature we added. It is how Valam is built.

items.title: Hardware protected vault
items.body: Your master key is sealed by the Secure Enclave on iPhone or the Keystore on Android and released only after Face ID, fingerprint or PIN.

items.title: Encrypted database
items.body: Your ledger, attachments and chat history are encrypted on the device. The vault closes and keys are wiped whenever the app locks.

items.title: Recovery key
items.body: A recovery key shown once at setup is the only other way in. Lose both and nobody, including us, can open your data.

items.title: Encrypted backups
items.body: Export a backup file that is encrypted with a key derived from your passphrase. Restore it on a new phone.

items.title: Privacy mode
items.body: Hide amounts with one tap when someone is looking over your shoulder.

items.title: No ads, no tracking
items.body: No advertising, no analytics SDKs and no selling of data.

plus.title: Start free. Add Plus when you want more.
plus.subtitle: The core app is free and fully private. Plus is optional and coming soon.
